name: Custom Shape Acrylic Book Display
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic.
    - Main stand panels: Acrylic 3mm.
    - Bottom panel: Acrylic 5mm for enhanced stability.
    - Note pieces: 2-layer acrylic (3mm each layer).
    - Built-in strong round magnets (up to 15 magnets) to securely attach note pieces.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - Acrylic thickness: approx. 0.12 in (3mm)
    - Note pieces: Max 5 pieces included.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using UV printing technology. Double-sided printing for both the main display and note pieces.
    - Vivid colors, sharp details, and long-lasting print quality.

 

  • Function & Usage: 
    - Designed as a decorative display and organization accessory.
    - Used to display messages, labels, reminders, or status notes in a clear and visually appealing way.
    - Magnetic note pieces allow easy updating, rearranging, and customization.
    - Suitable for use on desks, shelves, counters, workspaces, classrooms, or display areas.
    - Helps keep information visible, organized, and easy to change for daily or long-term use.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift suitable for a wide range of recipients.
    - Ideal for any occasion, such as birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, seasonal events, or special milestones.
    - A great choice for those who appreciate personalized, decorative, and practical items.
    - Suitable for gifting to family members, friends, colleagues, or loved ones.
    - Combines functionality and aesthetic appeal, making it a memorable keepsake for everyday use or display.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Acrylic Book Display

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
